title: Google Gemma 4 Global Downloads Surge Past 300 Million, the New Era of AI Has Fully Erupted!

content_html:
According to the latest news, the global downloads of Google Gemma4 series models have officially exceeded 300 million. This milestone was announced during Google I/O Shanghai.

Looking back to April this year, Google officially launched the new Gemma4 series model. As an artificial intelligence model designed for advanced reasoning and agentic workflows, it quickly gained significant attention and widespread application from developers and the tech community around the world after its release. Now, it has achieved an impressive milestone of over 300 million downloads.

据最新消息，谷歌Gemma4系列机型的全球下载量已正式突破3亿。 这一里程碑是在 Google I/O 上海期间宣布的。

回顾今年4月，谷歌正式推出了全新的Gemma4系列机型。 作为一种专为高级推理和代理工作流程而设计的人工智能模型，它发布后迅速获得了全球开发者和技术社区的高度关注和广泛应用。 现在，它已经实现了下载量超过 3 亿次的令人印象深刻的里程碑。
